method.client: curl with normal certificate validation and Python HTMLParser; no browser automation
method.scope: 20 new hub pages in five languages, FI/EN home and model/civilization/epistemology/about/evidence pages, 19 newly added FI reference detail pages, and four public downloadable data files.
method.claimCheck: Explicit source ClaimRef IDs and hub anchor IDs must be rendered; all nine new claim IDs must appear across checked pages; all rendered IDs must be registered.
method.navigationCheck: All seven ordered sections on every HTML page; exactly the owning active section; six About tabs with the correct current page.
method.downloadCheck: SHA-256 of public bytes compared with the exact local release copy.
method.limits: This bounded release check complements the 400-route/345-anchor local production-build audit and separate browser QA; no external article URLs fetched.
